title: Expected result of a conformance test
description: The expected result of one .figc or .figf file in tests/lang (see tests/lang/README.md).

doc.description: What the test checks, in one sentence.

mode.description: parse: lexing and parsing only (docs/language.md Sections 2 and 3, errors E1xxx and E2xxx). check: also names and types, without running (E1xxx to E4xxx). run: run the file.

errors.description: Every error the file must report, in the order of their positions. An empty list means the file must be accepted.
